text: パソコンの　がめんに　てんそうマシンと　でてます！

structure.jp: パソコンの　がめんに

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.explanation: と here works like quote marks around the words that appear on the screen. てんそうマシンと　でてます = 'it says "Teleporter"'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている says something has happened and stays that way. でてます is the short spoken form of でています. でてます = 'is showing'.
